items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was on, I was on sessions with each of these people

ctx.x: Right. I was on, I was on sessions with each of these people, and they just ask you, "You wanna do another one?" [laughs] Stuff like that, as I recall, you know.
They didn't hear, they didn't hear when you played a bad note and say, "Go back and do it?"
